snippet.title: Cosmolon Trailer | Se7enZ Studio (First Created Game)
snippet.description:
~Cosmolon~

Cosmolon is a Vampire Survivors-inspired game that pays a lot of respect to the MS DOS games of the past. In it, you control a frigate, can decide on upgrades, and take on many different enemy ships that behave differently from one another. There are powerups to collect, experience and levels to earn, and two bosses to destroy. The game is quite difficult, so prepare yourselves!

Are you ready to embark captain?

------------

Created By: Se7enZ
Pixel Art By: Se7enZ with Aseprite
Music By: Se7enZ with Beepbox
Coding By: Se7enZ with major assistance from Branno's Amazing Video Tutorial
Branno's Guide: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abA7TF7z6W8&list=PLtosjGHWDab682nfZ1f6JSQ1cjap7Ieeb

------------

Cosmolon will be released on PC on Steam.
Release Date: Coming Soon! Stay tuned!
Steam Page: Coming Soon!  Stay tuned!

------------

Hey! It is amazing the support I have received on learning game development and I plan on making more games in the future. If you wish to support my creations, then follow along! Cosmolon is my first game and I can't wait to see what I can figure out next.

You can support me through these two channels:

Se7enZ YT at: https://www.youtube.com/@The_Se7enZ
ErikDev YT at: https://www.youtube.com/@Se7enZStudio
